note: A delivery statement for a version the column is missing from is typed by widening the column's documented Datatyp together with the entry's curated data_type (#1562: it takes the place of SWECOV storage evidence); a type outside the widenable classes leaves it untyped. Expected literals: V1..V7 data types are the parametrize table of test_delivered_type_widens_documentation_and_storage (documented, storage, expected), one column per row, with each former storage type curated as its class (smallint -> integer, varchar -> text); V8 null and its issue detail ('Documented Datatyp: 2022=none', 'Curated data_type: none') from test_delivered_without_evidence_stays_untyped_and_names_missing_evidence; STMT text from test_delivery_statement_types_without_inheriting_flags_or_coding (varchar 2018 + integer 2022 -> text); BLK integer under the entry's column spelling from test_converted_blank_target_sets_type_and_stays_source_guarded (the blank row's column becomes the entry's VALUE and its data_type the donor's integer); ANC integer on v22 from test_delivered_anchor_selects_one_reused_column_identity (the anchor's identity and type, not var 23's text); the V1 provenance texts from the widening test's provenance asserts. The variable slugs v<var_id> are this curation's [variable] names. Every entry applies (the replaced tests assert `result.blockers == ()` and `applied.diagnostics == ()`), so no entry is stale or over-broad; in 2020 only the three untyped columns V6..V8 (v10, v11, v12) raise unknown_data_type, as the missing-evidence test asserts for an untyped addition, and the typed ones raise none. V1 (an added state) and BLK (a rewritten blank row) also author their delivery's measurement_unit (#1646): each 2020 state carries it, and every other delivery, documented with no unit and authoring none, has none. V1 and Blk are documented with those same units in 2022, so v5 and v31 keep a common unit and raise no delivery_units_vary. The v12 detail substrings are the missing-evidence test's own assertions: the detail is the only boundary signal naming the missing evidence (the issue's refs cite only source rows).
fails_if: `scb_errata.convert_delivered_entry` stops widening the documented and curated classes together (for example typing from the curated `data_type` alone), so V4, V5 and STMT lose their types and V2 no longer widens; or it drops the `native_variable_id` filter, so ANC turns ambiguous and gets no 2020 state; or it drops the curated `measurement_unit`, so V1's or BLK's 2020 state has no unit
